resources.string: After explicit launch, navigates only within ChatGPT and attempts one call-button click for your selected Dot, then checks a configured call-screen marker. Stops within 30 seconds. Reads screen labels, but does not store chat content, record audio, send messages, or use the internet. Configure and verify labels before enabling.

This starts a real call in the existing ChatGPT app. No TTS or API. Accessibility can read and control screens. This app acts only in ChatGPT for up to 30 seconds after launch. No internet permission, chat logging, audio recording, or backups. Names and labels stay on this device.

Verify exact accessibility text/content descriptions on your phone. English navigation defaults come from upstream and may not match your version. Call and call-screen labels are intentionally blank. No guessed labels or coordinates. Use a call-screen-only control such as the actual end-call control as confirmation; it is never clicked. This detects a screen, not audible connection.

Enable this service manually in Android Accessibility. To change settings later, long-press the app icon and choose Configure Dot call, or open this service's settings. Unlock before launching from Bixby or a routine.

State markers must be directly clickable, enabled Button/ImageButton accessibility nodes, not conversation text or hints. A missing tree waits at most 1 second after ChatGPT is seen. Interrupted pre-click sessions and requests from a previous process are cancelled. Uncheck authorization and save to revoke it even with incomplete fields.
Exact call button label (verify on device)
I verified these labels and authorize a single real ChatGPT call attempt each time I launch this shortcut.
Enter a Dot name and distinct verified labels; destination must include {dot}. Confirm the call authorization.
Unlock your phone and launch again.

Configure and verify labels before starting.

Timed out without starting a call. Verify Dot name and labels.

Call authorization revoked. Pending automation cancelled; an existing call is not ended.
Multiple sidebar or call-screen controls found. Automation stopped without another click. Check ChatGPT and any ongoing call manually.
